svg.text: 1 Pre-fix • 2 Post-Batch-2 • 3 Gate L3 • 4 Final Gate • 5 Post-Batch-7b. Blind synthetic confidence; lower is better.
1. Blind reviewer scores and five-stage running average
Blue band is reviewer range; black line is the running checkpoint average.
Red cells are higher synthetic-confidence scores.
Negative bars are improvements; positive bars are regressions.
Top line is max reviewer score, bottom line min reviewer score, blue line is spread.
Generated in the assessment-skill style from frozen checkpoint scores. Independent panels; directional comparison only. Lower is more realistic.
